astronomyEngineApsides.aberration: not documented in the pinned tables
astronomyEngineApsides.domain: pinned lunar and Earth tables beginning in 2001; sampled at 2001, 2050, and 2100
astronomyEngineApsides.frame: scalar Earth-Moon and Sun-Earth distances; no orientation frame
astronomyEngineApsides.license: Upstream transformation files retain the Astronomy Engine MIT license archived with these fixtures
astronomyEngineApsides.origin: Earth center for lunar distance and Sun center for Earth distance
